description.describe_ch: 建築施工圖的繪製是緊接在建築設計完成後的一道「界面整合」手續。施工圖的繪製一方面除了將初期的設計實質化(如：尺寸和材料選擇)外，同時也是作為參與人員的溝通工具與施工依據：對內與施工圖繪製人員討論；對外與專業廠商和業主協商。另外，施工圖的製作又牽涉到「建築法規檢討」和「施工成本估算」，可見施工圖在整個營建過程中所扮演的重要性。本施工圖的課程主要去強調施工圖之「界面整合」的功能。經由本課程，學生將建立一整體的施工圖相關知識：(1)瞭解那些界面(如：不同的材料和不同的專業廠商考量)需要仔細地處理與其施工的可行性；(2)具備基本的施工圖的繪圖能力；(3)習得讀圖和識圖的基本的技能；與(4)熟悉設計、施工圖及營造三者之間的緊密關連。
description.describe_eh: After the completion of architectural design, making architectural construction drawings is the following step, integrating various structural, mechanical and electrical considerations. Making these drawings not only transforms the initial design concept into the real measure and the possible material choices for the later construction, but is also used as the communication tool for people who involve in projects and as the reference for the entire construction process – between architects(designers) and drawers interiorly and between architects and professional vendors and clients. In addition, such drawings are associated with the examination of architectural regulations (or building ordinances) and the estimation of construction cost. Therefore, its importance cannot be neglect throughout the construction process. The instruction of Construction Drawings emphasize its role of integration. By attending this course, students will obtain knowledge and ability: (1) enabling to treat the locations where different construction materials meet and the areas where require communications with professional vendors and to seek for other alternative construction methods; (2) enabling to making construction drawings; (3) enabling to read drawings and identify symbols on them; and (4) enabling to recognize the important relationship among design, construction drawings and the construction process.
